text:
maya-cs: FYI onboarding for SignalWorks - after we flipped on the JS SDK heartbeat, their preflight traffic spiked and started getting intermittent 429s. Repro steps below, do we have quick mitigations?

jon-eng: Can you paste the short repro + client config? heartbeat interval, number of tabs/connections, token TTL?

maya-cs: Repro: single-page app with heartbeat enabled to keep websocket alive. They set heartbeat interval = 5s for rapid presence updates. Test ramp ~3k concurrent clients (simulated). Token TTL is 60s ephemeral. Log fragment:

[2026-03-22T16:12:03Z] preflight OPTIONS /v1/preflight 200 x-client-id=signalworks-123
[2026-03-22T16:12:03Z] preflight OPTIONS /v1/preflight 429 x-client-id=signalworks-123
[2026-03-22T16:12:04Z] preflight OPTIONS /v1/preflight 429 x-client-id=signalworks-123

Header they send: `x-sdk-heartbeat: 1` and we see a flood of OPTIONS + auth preflight.

lina-devex: Oof. Classic splay + short TTL combined with very short heartbeat. Two immediate options: (1) client-side: jitter the heartbeat and increase interval to >=15s; add random small offset so not all clients sync. Example JS: 

const jitter = () => Math.floor(Math.random()*10000);
setInterval(() => sendHeartbeat(), 15000 + jitter());

(2) server-side: enable preflight coalescing at the gateway and increase the preflight bucket for this onboarding org temporarily.

jon-eng: Confirming: our default preflight rate limit is per-key 120/min (burst allowed). With 3k concurrent clients each doing 5s heartbeats we blow that up. Short-term patch: ask them to change interval to 20s and add jitter. Medium-term: we can open a quota bump for their onboarding window.

sam-cs: @maya-cs can you send a one-pager with the exact client snippet + recommended settings? I'll coordinate the customer call for tomorrow and request they patch their test fleet. I'll also request the quota bump from ops if needed.

maya-cs: Will do. Quick follow-up - is there a recommended gateway flag we can flip to debounce preflight on our edge?

jon-eng: We have a config flag: PRELIGHT_COALESCE_WINDOW_MS. You can set to 10000ms to aggregate preflight checks by key. Default is 0. Ops can flip per-org for onboarding test.

infra-bot: Created incident ticket INC-1234: "SignalWorks onboarding preflight 429 - temporary quota bump & coalescing" (assigned to eng-infra).

lina-devex: Also FYI, if tokens refresh frequently (TTL 60s) encourage longer TTL during onboarding or use token refresh de-duplication. If token rotation is causing new preflight per refresh that adds to the burst.

maya-cs: Noted - I'll ask them to lengthen TTL in the test to 5m and jitter heartbeat. Sending patch now.

sam-cs: Thanks. I'll confirm after the call and close the loop with ops on the quota flip. :thumbsup: 

jon-eng: TL;DR: customer fix = increase heartbeat interval + jitter + longer test TTL. Our quick ops fix = enable PRELIGHT_COALESCE_WINDOW_MS=10000 for their org + temporary preflight quota bump.

maya-cs: Great, scheduling enablement call and will paste the snippet + logs into INC-1234.

sam-cs: I'll track renewal risk as "low" once we verify warmup mitigates 429s.

maya-cs: Closing loop here after the call, will update thread.
